name: @zerocmf/yishan
description: 移山通用管理系统 - 基于 React/Ant Design Pro、Fastify、Docusaurus 的 monorepo 解决方案

scripts.build: pnpm build:mobile && pnpm build:app && pnpm build:api && pnpm build:admin && pnpm --filter yishan-docs build
scripts.typecheck:admin: pnpm --filter @yishan/demo-admin exec max setup && pnpm --filter @yishan/core-admin typecheck && pnpm --filter @yishan/core-system-admin typecheck && pnpm --filter @yishan/demo-admin typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @yishan/core-admin lint && pnpm --filter @yishan/core-system-admin lint && pnpm --filter @yishan/demo-admin lint && pnpm --filter yishan-docs typecheck && pnpm --filter yishan-app lint && pnpm check:boundaries
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @yishan/core-app test && pnpm --filter yishan-app test && pnpm --filter @yishan/core-admin test && pnpm --filter @yishan/demo-admin test && pnpm test:api
scripts.check:boundaries: node scripts/check-api-architecture.cjs && node scripts/check-main-baseline.mjs && node scripts/check-module-naming.mjs && node scripts/check-admin-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-app-boundaries.mjs
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build:api && pnpm --filter @yishan/core-database test:mysql && pnpm --filter @yishan/core-system-api test:integration && pnpm --filter @yishan/demo-api test:integration
scripts.typecheck:mobile: pnpm --filter @yishan/core-app typecheck && pnpm --filter @yishan/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter yishan-app tsc
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @yishan/tiptap typecheck && pnpm typecheck:mobile && pnpm typecheck:api && pnpm typecheck:admin && pnpm --filter yishan-docs typecheck

author: yishan
